description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nuwara Wewa Nuwaragampalatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner details, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations and registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
